meta.title: Support us — Yog-Scope
meta.description: Ways to support Yog-Scope: star the repository, spread the word, send feedback, or donate in SOL.

header.title: Help us keep going.
header.lead: Yog-Scope is built and maintained independently. Each of these helps; at this stage, visibility and your feedback matter most.

ways.label: Free ways to help
ways.shareText: Yog-Scope — real-time observation of Meteora liquidity pools on Solana.

star.title: Star the repository
star.body: It's free and it helps other developers find the project.

share.title: Spread the word
share.body: Share the project with people who work on Solana, DeFi or liquidity analysis.

feedback.title: Send feedback
feedback.body: Bugs, feature ideas, remarks: everything is welcome. GitHub for technical matters, email for the rest.

sponsor.title: Sponsor the project
sponsor.body: You can support Yog-Scope financially with a direct donation in SOL, from any Solana wallet.
sponsor.check: Always check the address in your wallet before sending.
